query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Generate recurring daily activity summaries by collecting recent email activity, social page activity, and Fireflies meeting transcripts for a local-day reporting window.
query_ground_truth.intent: Retrieve all recent email messages received and sent within the reporting window.
